verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships Bionic, a built-in agent. You can work with it to create and edit documents with automatic saving, talk to it by voice with local transcription, and use it for "advanced agentic tasks" on local or frontier open models. A hands-on user reported that "it works great," though they noted rough edges such as an unclear working directory and no model preload or unload. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of what tasks and tools Bionic can handle autonomously, clarity on whether Bionic lives inside the main app or is a separate app, and more independent corroboration beyond a single first impression (a separate MCP agentic attempt in the main app got stuck in a loop).
